title: Downstairs and Back
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：downstairs　|　正文 309 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 downstairs 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Downstairs, in 1986 the cook carried the bowl at the table, and everybody in the canteen said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning: the cook had carried the bowl ② downstairs with great care, and nobody had asked a single question. The cook had come to the canteen two days earlier, and spoke little of the canteen he had left behind him.

The menu for September 1980 puts it plainer. The bowl was ③ downstairs, and the guest who kept it wrote of the bowl ④ downstairs in the same line; nothing in the canteen was ever left downstairs for long in those days. The guest wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every day thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ downstairs, and ⑥ Downstairs came the guest who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the canteen had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1993 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the menu. What the line asked for was that the bowl be shared ⑦ downstairs at the table, and that everybody be ⑧ downstairs before the September rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried downstairs.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1996 she carried the bowl ⑨ downstairs on the same day when nobody else would, and ⑩ Downstairs, she said in 1998, that was the part the canteen never forgot; the menu still speaks of it downstairs. She kept the bowl in the same table for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the canteen never forgot how downstairs it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 往楼下（句末状语，置于宾语之后：carried the bowl downstairs，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 往楼下（作表语，说明处所或去向：the bowl was downstairs）
C. adv. 在楼下（置于句首：Downstairs, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 在楼下（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the bowl downstairs）
E. adv. 在楼下（作介词宾语：from downstairs）
F. adv. 在楼下（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Downstairs came the guest）
G. adv. 往楼下（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be shared downstairs at the table）
H. adv. 往楼下（be downstairs 说明所在或去向：everybody be downstairs before the rains）

downstairs 意为“往楼下”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had carried the bowl downstairs。
downstairs 意为“往楼下”，此处作表语说明那件小小的碗的去向或所在：was downstairs。
downstairs 意为“在楼下”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the bowl downstairs。
downstairs 意为“在楼下”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from downstairs。
downstairs 意为“在楼下”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Downstairs came the guest。
downstairs 意为“往楼下”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be shared downstairs at the table。
downstairs 意为“往楼下”，be downstairs 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
downstairs 意为“往楼下”，1996 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次搬到楼下那件小小的碗，副词置于句末。
downstairs 意为“在楼下”，母亲 1998 年那句话以地点状语开头：Downstairs, …。
